payload.reason: Different variants of ROUGE scores yield varying correlations with human judgments, particularly in the context of scientific summarization.

claims.text: Rouge-2 and Rouge-3 are the highest correlated ROUGE variants with pyramid scores.
Different variants of ROUGE result in different correlation values with human judgments, indicating variability in effectiveness.
Rouge-1 and Rouge-L have the lowest F-score correlations, indicating they are less effective than other variants.
Keyword-based reduction variants show high correlation with ROUGE, suggesting some variants perform better than others.
